written.title: This Isn't A Video From Miami, It's A GTA 6 Gameplay Clip
written.description: What Kotaku, IGN and Push Square reported on 11 November 2026: "This Isn't A Video From Miami, It's A GTA 6 Gameplay Clip", in their own words.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Grand Theft Auto VI, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Kotaku, 11 November 2026

[This Isn't A Video From Miami, It's A GTA 6 Gameplay Clip](https://kotaku.com/this-isnt-a-video-from-miami-its-a-gta-6-gameplay-clip-2000756038)

The outlet's own summary:

> The video fooled many online who thought it was real life

> Some believe that if you look closely at the sidewalk, you can spot Jason and Lucia recording the second part of the video.

> Its latest move appears to be a gameplay clip showing off Vice City that tricked some people into thinking it was real footage.

## IGN, 12 November 2026

[New GTA 6 Gameplay Clip Showcases Hyper Realistic Graphics and Fans Can't Quite Believe It's Real](https://www.ign.com/articles/new-gta-6-in-game-footage-continues-to-highlight-the-games-unbelievable-graphics)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar has released yet another in-game clip from GTA 6, and like yesterday's footage, fans can't quite believe it's real.

> It's clear that Rockstar traded higher performance in favor of visual fidelity, and while that may not be what some fans want, it is inevitably going to result in one of the most graphically advanced games we have ever seen.

> The page posted footage of these cars sitting on GTA 6's version of Ocean Drive yesterday while a group of NPCs observed them.

## Push Square, 12 November 2026

[This GTA 6 Clip Looks So Real, Fans Can't Believe It's In-Game Footage](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/this-gta-6-clip-looks-so-real-fans-cant-believe-its-in-game-footage)

The outlet's own summary:

> #OnlyinViceCity

> The clip begins with a view from inside a moving vehicle as it drives past the Cortez Hotel, a Vice City location inspired by the real world Colony Hotel in Miami.

> Confirmed by Rockstar Games. pic.twitter.com/RsXST3C6t6 - GTA 6 Updates (@gtasix_) November 11, 2026 Originally posted by onlyindade on Instagram , the video has since been shared by the official Rockstar Games account, with many taking that as confirmation it's actually a video of Vice City within GTA 6.

## Push Square, 12 November 2026

[These New GTA 6 Clips Look So Real, Fans Can't Believe It's All In-Game Footage](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/these-new-gta-6-clips-look-so-real-fans-cant-believe-its-all-in-game-footage)

The outlet's own summary:

> #OnlyinViceCity

> I want it because I like GTA but Im waiting as I need to see how it runs on base PS5.

> 0 48 RoomWithaMoose 1 hour ago Listen, I really don't want to get into the Zelda vs.

> It is stunt, Jason films from car and Lucia does it from street.

> That short clip absolutely nails the vibe and atmosphere of Ocean Drive, one of Miami Beach’s most iconic streets!

> Obviously living there is different to visiting, but Ocean Drive felt so magical and I loved driving around the area toward it too.

> Same clop runned teitce, you can see both phones in hand to each other 1 15 Kidfunkadelic83 4 hours ago Im on the fence.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
